title: Remove Launch risk helper flat aliases
summary: Removed six Launch risk/readiness helpers from the transitional flat window surface while preserving their window.mediaPipelineLaunchView namespace exports.
reason: Continue namespace-first WebView cleanup in a Launch-owned touched domain without changing backend mutation, media policy, source handling, or pending-publish behavior.

rollback_plan: Restore the six Launch flat assignments, restore the inventory/current-state counts to 693 and launchView.js to 45, regenerate the WebView contract baseline and summaries, then rerun the same WebView validation ladder.
